faq.q: What is an AI ad image generator?
faq.a: It turns one product photo into a clean square image for a social feed. You add the headline and price in your ad editor.

faq.q: How do I create an image ad from a photo?
faq.a: Upload one clear product photo, choose a scene and describe the idea. Download the square result and add it to your campaign.

faq.q: Which platforms are the images ready for?
faq.a: The square image suits Facebook and Instagram feeds. Your ad platform controls any final crop for other spots.

faq.q: Can the image include my headline?
faq.a: The scene leaves room for copy, but it does not render readable words. Add the headline yourself so it stays correct and easy to change.

faq.q: Can I make several versions with one photo?
faq.a: Yes. Generate different scenes from the same product photo and compare the versions before you choose the ad.
Ecommerce brands, performance marketers and growth teams that need fresh feed ads without repeated photoshoots.

faq.q: Can I use the image in a live ad?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads have no watermark and are licensed for commercial use. Check the crop and safe areas in your ad tool before launch.

faq.q: Do I have to label the image as AI?
faq.a: Disclosure rules vary by platform and region. Follow the guidance shown in your ad tool for each campaign.
